node.title: Flow — from production incident to root cause
node.summary: The signature flow: a P1 incident traced back through deploy and PR to the AI session and the context it did or didn't have.
node.interview_question: When you say you trace an incident to the AI session that caused it — is that an observed edge or an inference at the PR/aggregate level?

competitor.name: Rootly
competitor.positioning: Rootly and incident.io tie an incident to its causing PR and resolve single incidents deeper than Faros — but they stop before the AI session and spend.
